- File: tests/test_clarify_informal_detect.py
  Line or code reference: 55, in `_assert_fixture`
  Problem: Signal comparison uses strict list equality (`assert signals == list(fixture["expected_signals"])`) rather than the set comparison mandated by the Phase 4 plan at `docs/plans/awesome-claude-code-learnings-plan.md` line 569, which specifies `assert set(actual_signals) == set(expected_signals)`.

The plan explicitly requires set-based comparison for this reason.
